method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no; NOTHING where it does not answer); the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; no regulative rule (the Act imposes no duty with a deadline); no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Law Reform (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1941 (WA), Act No. 29 of 1941, compilation including the Civil Liability Amendment (Provisional Damages for Dust Diseases) Act 2024 Part 3 (in force 1 December 2024), retrieved 7 September 2026 from the Western Australian Legislation website, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_47978.txt
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is (c) State of Western Australia, CC BY 4.0, from the Western Australian Legislation website; see SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seat: the claimant: mostly the person pursuing, for a dead person's estate, a claim the dead person had (executor, administrator or family member acting for the estate), including a dust-disease claim; also the injured person claiming against the estate of a wrongdoer who has died, the injured person or dependants whose lump-sum damages for future loss are discounted (s 5), and a married person (s 2, s 3) (lrmp-claims.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run lrmp-dates.l4 ; l4 run lrmp-claims.l4 ; l4 run lrmp-cases.l4
checks.result: 64 assertions written, 64 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text. A deliberately wrong assertion in a scratch copy showed as 'assertion failed'.

scope: The whole operative Act, from the claimant's seat. In: s 2, s 3, s 4 ((1A), (1) with its proviso, (2)(a)-(e), (2a), (3), (4), (5)), s 5(1), (3). Out: long title, s 1 (short title and commencement), s 5(2) (the Governor's power to fix a rate: machinery; whether an Order is in force, and its rate, are asked); the pre-2005 s 4 kept by the Limitation Legislation Amendment and Repeal Act 2005 s 15(4) for causes of action accrued before 15 November 2005 (not deposited: NOTHING). Reasons in NOTES.md.
